Appearance.d: Appearance specifies the visual properties of geometry by containing the Material, ImageTexture/MovieTexture/PixelTexture, FillProperties, LineProperties, programmable shader nodes (ComposedShader, PackagedShader, ProgramShader) and Textur…

AudioClip.d: AudioClip provides audio data used by parent Sound nodes.

Background.d: Background simulates ground and sky, using vertical arrays of wraparound color values.

BooleanFilter.d: BooleanFilter selectively passes true, false or negated events.

Box.d: Box is a geometry node specifying a rectangular cuboid.

CADAssembly.d: CADAssembly holds a set of Computer-Aided Design (CAD) assemblies or parts grouped together.

CADPart.d: CADPart is an atomic part that defines both coordinate-system location and the faces that constitute a part in a Computer-Aided Design (CAD) model.

Circle2D.d: Circle2D is a geometry node that defines a linear X-Y circle with center (0,0) in X-Y plane.

ClipPlane.d: ClipPlane specifies a single plane equation used to clip (i.

Color.d: Color node defines a set of RGB color values that apply either to a sibling Coordinate|CoordinateDouble node, or else to a parent ElevationGrid node.

ColorInterpolator.d: ColorInterpolator generates a range of color values.

ColorRGBA.d: ColorRGBA node defines a set of RGBA color values that apply either to a sibling Coordinate|CoordinateDouble node, or else to a parent ElevationGrid node.

ComposedShader.d: ComposedShader can contain field declarations, but no CDATA section of plain-text source code, since programs are composed from child ShaderPart nodes.

Coordinate.d: Coordinate builds geometry by defining a set of 3D coordinate (triplet) point values.

CoordinateDouble.d: CoordinateDouble builds geometry by defining a set of 3D coordinate (triplet) point values.

CoordinateInterpolator.d: CoordinateInterpolator linearly interpolates among a list of 3-tuple MFVec3f arrays, producing a single MFVec3f array that is fractional average between two nearest arrays in the list.

CoordinateInterpolator2D.d: CoordinateInterpolator2D generates a series of SFVec2f or MFVec2f 2-tuple float values.

DirectionalLight.d: DirectionalLight might not be scoped by parent Group or Transform at levels 1 or 2.

Disk2D.d: Disk2D is a geometry node that defines a filled (or partially filled) planar circle with center (0,0).

EXPORT.d: Functional summary: EXPORT exposes a local node for ROUTE passing of event values when the current Scene is included via Inline by a parent external world. These connections allow event values to be exchanged via ROUTE statements between a…

ElevationGrid.d: ElevationGrid is a geometry node defining a rectangular height field, with default values for a 1m by 1m square at height 0.

EnvironmentLight.d: EnvironmentLight node uses an environment map to represent incident illumination around a point, and can be used to show reflections of distant objects.

EspduTransform.d: EspduTransform is a networked Transform node that can contain most nodes.

Extrusion.d: Extrusion is a geometry node that sequentially stretches a 2D cross section along a 3D-spine path in the local coordinate system, creating an outer hull.

FontLibrary.d: FontLibrary can load additional fonts for use by Text and FontStyle nodes.

FontStyle.d: FontStyle is an X3DFontStyleNode that defines the size, family, justification, and other styles used by Text nodes.

ForcePhysicsModel.d: ForcePhysicsModel applies a constant force value to the particles.

Gain.d: The Gain node amplifies or deamplifies the input signal.

GaussianSplats.d: The GaussianSplats node adds basic support for direct real-time radiance field rendering of volume data without converting into surface or line primitives.

GeoCoordinate.d: GeoCoordinate builds geometry as a set of geographic 3D coordinates.

GeoElevationGrid.d: GeoElevationGrid is a geometry node defining a rectangular height field, with default values for a 1m by 1m square at height 0.

GeoLOD.d: Note that MFNode rootNode field can contain multiple nodes and has accessType inputOutput. Meanwhile MFNode children field is outputOnly, unlike other X3DGroupingNode exemplars.

GeoLocation.d: GeoLocation positions a regular X3D model onto the earth's surface.

GeoOrigin.d: GeoOrigin is deprecated and discouraged (but nevertheless allowed) in X3D version 3.3. GeoOrigin is restored in X3D version 4.0 for special use on devices with limited floating-point resolution.

GeoProximitySensor.d: GeoProximitySensor generates events when the viewer enters, exits and moves within a region of space (defined by a box).

GeoViewpoint.d: GeoViewpoint specifies viewpoints using geographic coordinates.

Group.d: Group is a Grouping node that can contain most nodes.

HAnimDisplacer.d: HAnimDisplacer nodes alter the shape of coordinate-based geometry within parent HAnimSegment or ancestor HAnimHumanoid nodes.

HAnimHumanoid.d: The HAnimHumanoid node is used to: (a) store references to the joints, segments, sites, skeleton, optional skin, and fixed viewpoints, (b) serve as a container for the entire humanoid, (c) provide a convenient way of moving the humanoid th…

HAnimJoint.d: HAnimJoint node can represent each joint in a body.

HAnimMotion.d: An HAnimMotion node supports discrete frame-by-frame playback for HAnim motion data animation.

HAnimPose.d: HAnimPose nodes support setting HAnimJoint values in a corresponding HAnimHumanoid skeleton.

HAnimSegment.d: HAnimSegment node contains Shape geometry for each body segment, providing a visual representation of the skeleton segment.

HAnimSite.d: An HAnimSite node serves three purposes: (a) define an end effector location which can be used by an inverse kinematics system, (b) define an attachment point for accessories such as jewelry and clothing, and (c) define a location for a Vi…

IMPORT.d: Functional summary: IMPORT provides ROUTE access to a node that has a corresponding EXPORT statement within an Inline scene. These connections allow event values to be exchanged via ROUTE statements between a parent model and a child Inlin…

IS.d: Functional summary: the IS statement connects node fields defined inside a ProtoBody declaration back to corresponding ProtoInterface fields. IS/connect statements can be added if the parent node is within a ProtoBody and connect statement…

ImageTexture.d: ImageTexture maps a 2D-image file onto a geometric shape.

IndexedFaceSet.d: IndexedFaceSet defines polygons using index lists corresponding to vertex coordinates.

IndexedLineSet.d: IndexedLineSet defines polyline segments using index lists corresponding to vertex coordinates.

Inline.d: Inline can load another X3D or VRML model into the current scene via url.

InlineGeometry.d: InlineGeometry loads geometry from an external file.

IntegerSequencer.d: IntegerSequencer generates periodic discrete integer values.

IsoSurfaceVolumeData.d: IsoSurfaceVolumeData displays one or more surfaces extracted from a voxel dataset.

LOD.d: LOD (Level Of Detail) uses camera-to-object distance to switch among contained child levels.

Layout.d: Layout node is used as layout field of LayoutLayer and LayoutGroup nodes.

LineProperties.d: LineProperties allows precise fine-grained control over the rendering style of lines and edges for associated geometry inside the same Shape.

LineSet.d: LineSet is a geometry node that can contain a Coordinate|CoordinateDouble node and optionally a Color|ColorRGBA node.

Material.d: Material specifies surface rendering properties for associated geometry.

MetadataFloat.d: The metadata provided by this node is contained in the single-precision floating point numbers of the value field.

MetadataSet.d: The metadata provided by this node is contained in the metadata nodes of the value field.

MetadataString.d: The metadata provided by this node is contained in the strings of the value field.

MotorJoint.d: MotorJoint drives relative angular velocities between body1 and body2 within a common reference frame.

MovieTexture.d: MovieTexture applies a 2D movie image to surface geometry, or provides audio for a Sound node.

NavigationInfo.d: NavigationInfo describes the user's viewing model, user navigation-interaction modalities, and also dimensional characteristics of the user's (typically invisible) avatar.

Normal.d: Normal defines a set of 3D surface-normal vectors that apply either to a sibling Coordinate | CoordinateDouble node, or else to a parent ElevationGrid node.

OrientationInterpolator.d: OrientationInterpolator generates a series of 4-tuple axis-angle SFRotation values.

OrthoViewpoint.d: OrthoViewpoint provides an orthographic perspective-free view of a scene from a specific location and direction.

PhysicalMaterial.d: PhysicalMaterial specifies Physically Based Rendering (PBR) properties for associated geometry.

PointLight.d: Linear attenuation may occur at level 2, full support at level 3.

PointSet.d: PointSet is a node that contains a set of colored 3D points, represented by contained Color|ColorRGBA and Coordinate|CoordinateDouble nodes.

PositionInterpolator.d: PositionInterpolator generates a series of 3-tuple SFVec3f values.

ProtoBody.d: ProtoBody contains the definition nodes for new Prototype nodes.

ProtoDeclare.d: ProtoDeclare defines new Prototype nodes. Nested ProtoDeclares and ProtoInstances are allowed by the X3D Architecture specification.

ProtoInstance.d: ProtoInstance can override field default values via fieldValue initializations. Non-recursive nested ProtoInstance and ProtoDeclare statements are allowed within a ProtoDeclare.

ProtoInterface.d: ProtoInterface defines fields for new Prototype nodes.

ProximitySensor.d: ProximitySensor generates events when the viewer enters, exits and moves within a region of space (defined by a box).

ROUTE.d: ROUTE connects output fields of event-producing nodes to input fields of event-consuming nodes.

Rectangle2D.d: Rectangle2D is a geometry node that defines a 2D rectangle in X-Y plane.

RenderedTexture.d: RenderedTexture is a texture node that renders the view from a local viewpoint or separate scene into an offscreen buffer, producing an image or depth map that can be rendered from model geometry in real time.

Scene.d: Scene is the implicit root node of the X3D scene graph.

Script.d: Script contains author-programmed event behaviors for a scene.

Shape.d: Shape can appear under any grouping node.

Sound.d: The Sound node controls the 3D spatialization of sound playback by a child AudioClip or MovieTexture node.

Sphere.d: Sphere is a geometry node, representing a perfectly round geometrical object that is the surface of a completely round ball.

Switch.d: Switch is a Grouping node that only renders one (or zero) child at a time.

Tangent.d: Tangent defines a set of 3D surface-normal vectors that apply either to a sibling Coordinate|CoordinateDouble node, or else to a parent ElevationGrid node.

Text.d: Text is a 2D (flat) geometry node that can contain multiple lines of string values.

TextureCoordinate.d: TextureCoordinate specifies 2D (s,t) texture-coordinate points, used by vertex-based geometry nodes (such as IndexedFaceSet or ElevationGrid) to map textures to vertices (and patches to NURBS surfaces).

TextureProjector.d: TextureProjector is similar to a light that projects a texture into the scene, illuminating geometry that intersects the perspective projection volume.

TextureTransform.d: TextureTransform shifts 2D texture coordinates for positioning, orienting and scaling image textures on geometry.

TextureTransformMatrix3D.d: TextureTransformMatrix3D applies a 3D transformation to texture coordinates.

TimeSensor.d: TimeSensor continuously generates events as time passes.

TouchSensor.d: TouchSensor tracks location and state of the pointing device, detecting when a user points at or selects (activates) geometry.

Transform.d: Transform is a Grouping node that can contain most nodes.

UniversalJoint.d: UniversalJoint is like a BallJoint that constrains an extra degree of rotational freedom.

UnlitMaterial.d: UnlitMaterial specifies surface rendering properties for associated geometry that is unaffected by scene lighting.

Viewpoint.d: Viewpoint provides a specific location and direction where the user may view the scene.

VolumeData.d: VolumeData displays a simple non-segmented voxel dataset with a single RenderStyle node.

WorldInfo.d: WorldInfo contains a title and simple persistent metadata information about an X3D scene. This node is strictly for documentation purposes and has no effect on the visual appearance or behaviour of the world.

connect.d: Functional summary: connect statements define event-routing connections between node fields defined inside a ProtoBody declaration back to corresponding ProtoInterface fields.

field.d: Functional summary: a field statement defines an interface attribute or node. Each field statement can contain either attribute-value or node content.
